paper_title: Axion Dark Matter from Cosmic String Network
notes: Lattice-simulation study of axion dark matter radiated from post-inflationary global cosmic strings (N^3=4096^3, fat-string and thermal pre-evolutions). The paper's headline result (Sec. 8.1, Eq. 21) is a cosmological LOWER BOUND ON THE QCD AXION MASS: m_a >~ 420 ueV (fat-string) / 470 ueV (thermal), equivalently f_a/N_W <= 1.3e10 GeV (fat-string) / 1.1e10 GeV (thermal), obtained by requiring the string-radiated axion abundance not exceed the observed DM density. This is a theoretical/cosmological prediction of the axion mass window derived from simulations, quoted as a single mass value, not an experimental or observational exclusion on any of the canonical detection couplings, and not expressible as a (mass, coupling) exclusion curve. No new measured coupling limit is reported. is_new_limit=false; not a sensitivity projection either.
